quotes.text: We had an epic day on the water with Captain Pete this week. Conditions were right, and Pete put us on the fish. He’s extremely knowledgeable of the area and the local fisheries, has top notch equipment, and knows how to put it to use. I caught my first Bull Red with him this past March, and was able to get several 30# Bulls to the boat on a popper on top this trip, which is an incredible thing to see. I look forward to coming back in August to fish with him again for another day or two. Best chartered day I’ve ever had on the water period,

Marsh On The Fly’s Captain Justin McGoey is a local native who has been guiding since age 18. He lives on the water and met us at the marina in his custom aluminum weld Mud Buddy powered skiff. We ran 45 min to his secret spots deep into the backcountry where we found solitude and happy fish willing to eat our fly. Even though Justin was right in the middle of a heavy run of back-to-back guide trips, he was upbeat, hard working, and fun to be in the boat with. 5 stars and looking forward to going out with him again!

Red fishing doesn't get any better then this! Captain Pete is a great guy and a great guide that puts in the extra work to make your experience the best! Owning a fly fishing guide service myself I know how much time and energy it takes to make a quality experience for all your guests and Capt Pete does not cut any corners. We fished 3 days which was the perfect amount of time to chase those Red's! We even got into some monster Jack's in a fly rod too!

Went out with Captain Peter, great day on the water. Boat is super clean and very comfortable ride. Great gear, various fly and spinning rods to use. Peter was very patient, even when I was having a "meltdown" casting to redfish in the flats and forgot all the basics of fly casting... anyway book a trip if you want a chance to catch big fish with knowledgeable guides

Captain Pete was awesome! Incredibly knowledgeable and patient. He took a novice fly fisherman and with some direction had me dropping the flies on the fish. With some more experience on my part and Pete poling, no telling how many more fish we would of landed. If you’re looking for a guide this is your guy! You won’t be disappointed.

Had a fantastic experience fishing with Pete. Lost count of the Redfish we caught, including my new PB. Pete is genuinely committed to the fishery and its preservation. Plus he’s an excellent photographer, capturing photos and video beyond the typical fish pics. Will absolutely fish with him again.
